title: At the Library Help Desk
instructions: 这是为A1水平学习者设计的听力练习。请先听录音（或阅读听力原文），然后回答问题。题目均为单选题或填空题，填空题答案必须与原文完全一致。所有内容为模拟教学材料，并非官方雅思考试。
transcript:
A: Good morning. Are you a student here?
B: No, I am not. I am a new teacher. My name is Chen.
A: Oh, welcome! I am Li. I am a librarian. Is this your first day?
B: Yes, it is. But I am not ready. Where is the teachers' room?
A: It is on the second floor. Is that your bag?
B: No, it is not my bag. My bag is blue. This bag is black.
A: Who is the man over there?
B: He is Mr. Wang. He is not a teacher. He is a cook.
A: Is he busy now?
B: No, he is not. He is free. He is happy.
A: Are you free at ten?
B: Yes, I am. I am free at ten. Thank you!

grammar.title: be 动词否定句与一般疑问句
grammar.explanation: 英语中，be 动词（am, is, are）的否定句是在 be 动词后加 not，例如：I am not a student. 一般疑问句是把 be 动词放到主语前面，例如：Are you a student? 回答用 Yes, I am. 或 No, I am not. 注意：肯定回答不能缩写（Yes, I am. 不说 Yes, I'm.），否定回答可以缩写（No, I'm not.）。
grammar.example: Are you a student here? No, I am not.

questions.explanation: 否定句在 be 动词后加 not，所以是 I am not a teacher.
